description: React component for rendering an audio waveform visualization with play/pause controls, waveform generation, and seeking functionality.

methods.name: generateWaveform
methods.description: Generates waveform data from an audio buffer for visualization.

methods.name: generatePlaceholderWaveform
methods.description: Creates a synthetic waveform pattern as a placeholder.

methods.name: drawWaveform
methods.description: Draws the waveform visualization on the canvas element.

methods.name: handlePlayPause
methods.description: Handles toggling between play and pause states.

methods.name: handleCanvasClick
methods.description: Handles seeking in the audio when clicking on the waveform canvas.
